text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience, and I’d love to support your Amazon private label business.

I can help with product research, data analysis, dashboarding, and listing optimization using SQL, Excel, Power BI, and Google Sheets. In a Sales KPI dashboard project, I built one Power BI report on a star-schema model to replace 14 separate Excel sales reports, which reduced monthly close reporting from 3 days to 4 hours. In a Marketing attribution analysis project, I joined ad spend with GA4 sessions in BigQuery to compare attribution models, helping reallocate 18% of ad budget and reduce CAC by 12% the next quarter.

I’m detail-oriented, organized, and comfortable working with data to support inventory planning, market trends, and performance tracking. I’d be glad to help your team move faster and make better decisions.
